M34 fuzz invariant: no teleportation; |dx_com - v*dt| residual must stay at numerical-noise level (k=1: any real motion is v*dt; threshold 1e-4 m = 0.1 mm slack)

M34 fuzz invariant: sqrt(Fx^2+Fy^2) <= mu*Fz on every loaded wheel; combined-slip model bounds it by construction, margin 0.001 for float rounding

Measured max 3.33 deg (M34 hunt)
M34 fuzz invariant: kingpin/saddle constraint position error <= 5 mm (same as soak)
M34 fuzz invariant: no negative air pressure in any reservoir/line (physical impossibility)
